[b]Kakigōri Mini Set (Replaces Ice Cream Recipe and Summer Stand)[/b]

I was craving some more Japanese-themed cuisine in the game, and got inspired by Obon and my all-time favourite festive dessert, kakigōri!
It's just crushed ice sweetened with syrup but it's sooo good in the summer, when the heat and the humidity are unbearable.

In the game the item shows up without the unique character since Stardew doesn't recognise non-English lettering.

[img]https://thelonelylacuna.files.wordpress.com/2017/04/kakigori-recipe2.png[/img]

The kakigōri recipe uses one strawberry (for the syrup) and sugar (to sweeten). The ice is kinda moot - not gonna program it into Pierre's shop as an ingredient since you could theoretically get 'water' from the sink in the kitchen :) Everything else about kakigōri in-game is the same as with ice cream - it has the same selling and buying prices, the recipe is given by Jodi once you reach 7+ hearts of affection and it is a loved gift for all the villagers who originally loved ice cream.

In summer you can buy it from Alex at the ice cream stand - which has also received a kakigōri-style makeover to fit the theme.

[font=Verdana][size=3][b][color=#e06666]How to Install[/color]
[/b][/size]
→ Download the .rar file from the [Downloads] tab above and extract with WinRAR
→ Open the Stardew Valley Content directory in a new window:
[quote][color=#ffffff]Usually this directory is under:
Program Files (x86) → Steam → steamapps → common → Stardew Valley → Content[/color][/quote]
[/font][font=Verdana]→ Open Content → Data. Copy in the new ObjectInformation.xnb and CookingRecipes.xnb files (make sure to keep backups of the originals somewhere).
→ Now go to Content → Maps and copy in the new springobjects.xnb and summer_town.xnb files (again, back up the original file somewhere)
→ You're done! Start your game up and cosplay as your favourite cardcaptor! :3[/font]
